verdicts.reason: B1 fails: the brief says a manager accepts the lines, so gated must be true with the accept named as the absent step, but the claim has gated=false and an empty gate (B7 is also weak, since a req-line quote resolver is buildable with the registered Bash:python3).
B3 fails: the done-when bundles two independent programs, a jq schema validation of keys and values and a separate substring check of each quote against the resume, so it is two directives.
B7 fails: a structured screen-form schema registry duplicates what registered Bash:jq already checks and would not turn the evidence-or-blank judgment (is the quote real) into a check.
B4 fails: laying existing per-line screen notes into a candidates-by-lines grid with nulls preserved is a mechanical jq join a program alone clears, so L1 is dearer than the L0 needed.

All rules hold: gated=true with tool none and the gate naming absent hire, offer, and send, a single sheet check at L3 human-only, a forbidden move matching the brief's stop-and-a-human-hires, distinct keywords, and absent tools that are not in the registered tools.
